title: RAW UNREVIEWED: pulse site and beating organ as related but distinct referents
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Find a dated medical primary that explicitly names a palpated pulse at a body site and the heart as its source, preserving site and cause as separate written claims. On an admitted bodily panel, require author-visible placement of two complete inscriptions and a second independent owner before assigning either term. Repeated circular marks or body proximity are only structural cues.

design.unit: two complete site-owned body inscriptions plus connected explanation
design.contrast: pulse-site term and heart term versus two interchangeable body labels
design.prediction: fixed whole-group roles track observed peripheral site and asserted source across independent owned bodily records
